name: Fire & Emergency Exit Safety
description: Inspects emergency exits, extinguisher readiness, signage, path blockages, and walkway clearance width.
disclaimer: AuditLens is an assistive pre-audit tool. It does not certify legal compliance. Verify against local regulations and a qualified inspector.

rules.title: Fire extinguisher is mounted and clearly visible
rules.fix_text: Install or relocate a certified fire extinguisher to an unobstructed, clearly marked wall mount.

rules.title: Emergency exit sign is illuminated and clearly visible
rules.fix_text: Ensure emergency exit signs are illuminated, unobstructed, and positioned above all exit doors.

rules.title: At least two independent emergency exit pathways are visible
rules.fix_text: Designate and clearly mark a secondary emergency exit path conforming to occupant capacity requirements.

rules.title: Emergency exit corridors and doors are free of blocking obstacles
rules.fix_text: Immediately remove all boxes, pallets, and temporary storage from designated exit routes.

rules.title: Emergency exit path maintains minimum clear width of 1.0 meter
rules.fix_text: Reorganize stored items and furniture so at least 1.0 m clear walkway width is continuously preserved.
